# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_SPIKE_REVERSAL_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
An unusually high volume spike within the first 15 min that pushes price beyond the opening range, followed by a rapid reversal candle, signals a short‑term fade. This pattern captures exhaustion of initial breakout momentum, offering a fade opportunity when retail-driven volume spikes fail to sustain follow-through.

## Mechanism
Entry rule: If the 5‑minute bar within the first 15 min records volume > 2× the average volume of the prior 20 bars AND price closes outside the opening range (below OR low for short bias) AND the next 5‑minute bar closes back inside the OR with a bearish engulfing pattern (close < open and open > prior close), enter at the close of that second bar. Exit: Stop at the high of the second bar (chart‑stop), target at 1× risk‑reward (equal to stop distance), with optional runner using a 12‑period EMA trailing stop. Regime filters: Only active when VIX < 20 AND opening range width < 0.2% of SPY price; disabled when VIX > 25 OR OR width > 0.5%.
